name: Bahrain

flag.description: A red field with a white vertical band at the hoist, separated from the red by a serrated edge forming five white triangular points.
flag.symbolism: The five white points represent the Five Pillars of Islam; red is the traditional colour of the Gulf states and white stands for peace.

hook: Bahrain has five white zigzag points on bright red (Five Pillars); Qatar's flag is maroon, much longer and has nine points.
trivia: The number of points was reduced from eight to five in 2002.
Red-and-white Gulf flags trace back to an 1820 treaty with Britain that required friendly Arab vessels to fly red flags with a white border.
Bahrain is an archipelago of over 30 natural islands, joined to Saudi Arabia by the 25 km King Fahd Causeway.
